Kyle Field counter-UAS: scenario display

Pick a scenario, press Play. The view shows what the sensors see. The right side shows how each track is categorized and what the operator would see. This is a visual shell for showing scenarios, sensor coverage and camera beams. It does not run our current ML model and the calls are scripted from an earlier prototype.

Each click draws a random, uncurated run under that condition (not hand-picked).

    Event log

      Simulated flights and assumed sensor performance. Track calls are scripted from an earlier prototype and replayed here for display only, they are not results from our current classifier. A call must persist 2 s to step up in concern and 8 s to step down. Status is what the operator gets: a threat call only becomes an ALARM once it is a confirmed drone (camera, rotor signature or drone radio) and urgent (over the bowl, within 600 m, or under 2 minutes away); until then it shows as confirming. Six sites: four stadium corner roofs (camera + RF sensor) and the Central Campus and West Campus garage roofs (radar + camera + RF sensor). The six cameras are shared: each looks at one drone at a time, assigned by urgency, and only where it has a clear line of sight. Line of sight for every sensor uses our FreeCAD stadium model and campus buildings from OpenStreetMap (most heights estimated from floor counts; trees not included).
